question.text: What is the typical range of delta for a long call option (i.e., a call option buyer's position)?

explanation.text: The Logic: For a long call (call option buyer), delta ranges from 0 to +1: deep OTM call delta is near 0, ATM call delta is around 0.5, and deep ITM call delta approaches +1. Long calls move in the same direction as the underlying, so delta is non-negative. The Trap: The short-call (call writer) position has delta in the range 0 to -1, which is why the original unqualified "call option" stem made option B (-1 to 0) also defensible. Option C (-1 to +1) is the range across the long + short call together. Option D is incorrect because delta is bounded by ±1. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII Equity Derivatives Certification Examination, December 2025 v1, pp. 77 and 125. The portfolio delta table on p. 125 distinguishes long call (0 to +1) from short call (0 to -1). The stem has been qualified to "long call / call option buyer" to remove that ambiguity.
